blocks.text: Pehli qatar ke transition elements badalte oxidation states dikhate hain kyunke 3d aur 4s subshells ki tawanai bohat milti julti hai. 4s electrons ki tarah 3d electrons bhi aasani se nikal sakte hain, is liye dono bonding mein hissa lete hain. 3d dhaat ka atom sirf apne 4s electrons kho sakta hai, jo aam taur par +2 state deta hai, ya 4s ke saath kuch 3d electrons bhi, jo oonche states dete hain. Manganese sab se ooncha, +7, tak pohanchta hai. Qatar mein sab se ooncha oxidation state manganese tak barhta aur phir ghat'ta hai (parabolic rujhan).

blocks.prompt: Co2+ aur Co3+ ki electronic configurations likh kar har aik mein unpaired d electrons ki tadaad maloom karein.
blocks.explanation: Co2+: [Ar] 3d7, teen unpaired electrons. Co3+: [Ar] 3d6, chaar unpaired electrons (azad ion mein, pehle paanchon d orbitals mein aik aik bhar kar).

blocks.prompt: Transition metals ki kasafat aur pighalne ke darje Group 1 dhaaton se kaheen zyada kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Transition metal ke atoms chhote aur bhari hain aur metallic bonding mein 3d aur 4s dono electrons use karte hain, is liye atoms qareeb qareeb jamte aur bonding Group 1 dhaat ke aik s electron se kaheen mazboot hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: Sc3+ ion [Ar] 3d0 4s0 hai. Scandium ko transition element kyun nahi kaha jata?
blocks.explanation: Is ka wahid mustahkam ion, Sc3+, khaali 3d subshell rakhta hai, is liye yeh adhoore d subshell wala koi mustahkam ion nahi banata.

items: 3d aur 4s tawanai mein qareeb, is liye dono ke electrons nikal sakte.
+2 aam; Mn +7 tak; sab se ooncha state qatar mein barh kar ghat'ta.
